skills.name: Hold
skills.description: stay at current position and stay alert

skills.name: TakeCover
skills.description: move behind a cover point that blocks a threat

skills.name: Support
skills.description: stay close to the player and assist them

skills.name: Suppress
skills.description: fire at an enemy position to pin them down

skills.name: Regroup
skills.description: move back to the player's position

skills.name: GatherWood
skills.description: walk to a wood deposit and collect wood

skills.name: MineStone
skills.description: walk to a stone deposit and mine stone

skills.name: Build
skills.description: help finish a blueprint the player already placed by feeding it resources

skills.name: Repair
skills.description: feed resources into a damaged wall to patch it up
